introHtml: Relaxed fit safety gear provides extra room and comfort for workers who need freedom of movement on the job. Unlike standard sizes, relaxed fit designs accommodate layers, bending, and lifting without binding. Whether you need safety vests, tees, or glasses with adjustable frames, this fit ensures all-day wearability for crews in construction, warehousing, or field service. Add your logo through screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that your team will actually want to wear.
